**Strale delivers decision-ready outcomes for agents.** Our flagship product, Counterparty Assurance, returns a complete counterparty answer in a single auditable call: identity, sanctions, ownership, bank verification. Coverage across EU and UK via direct government registry integrations and licensed providers. Operated by Moonlighter AB, Stockholm.
Strale operates two surfaces: [strale.io](http://strale.io) for Counterparty Assurance, and [strale.dev](http://strale.dev) for the agent capabilities API. Backend unified at [api.strale.io](http://api.strale.io). Per DEC-20260502-A and DEC-20260503-A.
